messages:
deploy-bot: canary rollout v0.45.2 -> canary (12%) complete. starting post-deploy smoke window (15m): prefill, gen-short synth, health pings
zoe: kicking off synths. watching prefill hit-rate, gen p95, and container restart counts
rick: quick stat: prefill hit-rate in canary dropped to 64% (baseline 99%) within first 90s
perf-bot: alert: synth failures s-2101..s-2108 = 8/50 failed -> 502 backend_error, p95 gen +140ms
nate: any infra events?
ops-bot: host prefill-canary-1 shows elevated disk IO and slow RPC latencies to prefill-shard-3
zoe: logs indicate prefill-service returned "cache-miss, triggering remote fetch" more often, increased tail latency
rick: v0.45.2 enabled prefill-batch-aggregation and aggressive async-fetch for cold keys. might have amplified remote fanout
zoe: playbook trigger: if prefill hit-rate < 80% and gen p95 regression > 100ms -> apply canary detour to stable-prefill and flip ff-prefill-agg=false on canary
ops-bot: applying detour: route prefill requests from canary to stable-prefill-pool. toggling ff-prefill-agg=false for canary (~20s)
ops-bot: detour applied. re-evaluating synths
perf-bot: post-detour: prefill hit-rate 96%, gen p95 back to +8ms, synth failures resolved
nate: good signal. holding global rollout per SOP for remaining 12m
zoe: adding note to release changelog: "canary detour: routed prefill to stable pool and disabled prefill aggregation due to cold-key fanout causing remote fetch surge"
rick: creating follow-up ticket to tune async-fetch backpressure and shard overflow handling. will include synth payloads and prefill metrics snapshot
ops-bot: also flagging prefill-shard-3 for capacity increase in next infra cycle
zoe: one suggestion: add a quickcheck probe that simulates cold-key fanout during canary warmup to catch this earlier
nate: +1. will add to runbook improvements
ops-bot: hold applied to rollout. monitoring continues. no new 5xxs in last 6m
perf-bot: archiving synth run artifacts to gs://release-artifacts/v0.45.2/prefill-detour-6854321987.zip
zoe: if clean at end of window we proceed with phased rollout. otherwise we'll escalate to rollback across envs
rick: thanks all. will attach repro script in the ticket and try to run a controlled cold-key spike in staging
ops-bot: thread archived in release-log. end of thread.
